subject: meta: fix infoschema compare foreign key field is null to decide whether it must load (#60235)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent focusing on meta/infoschema must-load filtering and DDL placement-policy dependency scan. `pkg/meta/meta.go` now treats `fk_info` being `null` vs `[]` equivalently when deciding “must load”, while still forcing load when `fk_info` is non-empty; verified JSON field order assumptions against `model.TableInfo` (ForeignKeys precedes Partition) and `TableInfo.Clone()` normalization behavior that explains the `null` vs `[]` variants. `pkg/ddl/placement_policy.go` fixes a malformed filter substring (extra quote) so placement-policy dependency scanning can actually skip tables with both `partition` and `policy_ref_info` null (performance-only change, no correctness regression). Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and saw subsequent refactors/extensions in the same area (e.g. affinity filtering) but no follow-up fix indicating a latent correctness issue in this commit.
